items.label: library_place_hold
items.value: Place a hold on a book for a student id, such as st_5678, with parameters book_id and student_id; adds a record

items.value: A JSON array only, no prose

items.label: Fields
items.value: name, description, inputSchema, annotations

challenges.title: Plan a three-page site build

items.label: Pages
items.value: site/index.html, site/projects.html, site/contact.html

items.label: Shared
items.value: site/styles.css

items.label: Stages
items.value: Plan, styles, one step per page, review, final fix or merge

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof, budget

items.label: Review
items.value: Required, with kind "review": the contact page has a form

items.label: Format
items.value: JSON only, in the lesson's example shape

criteria: Has a plan step, a styles step, one step per page, a review step and a final fix or merge step.
Every step has a title, an owner, a changes list, a dependsOn list, a proof and a budget.
Dependencies point only to steps that exist, with no cycle.
No two steps that can run at the same time list the same file in changes.
The review step (kind review) depends on all three page steps and the styles step.
There are no loops, or every loop has an until exit test and a maxRounds cap.

items.label: Stages

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof, budget

items.label: Loop

challenges.title: Plan a docs refresh across three packages
challenges.brief: Get the model to plan a coordinator-and-workers refresh of the docs in three packages as a JSON graph, with one writer per package working at the same time.

items.label: Style guide
items.value: docs/STYLE.md, written first by the coordinator

items.label: Package docs
items.value: packages/core/docs/, packages/cli/docs/, packages/web/docs/: one writer step each, and each step changes only its own folder

items.label: Index
items.value: docs/index.md, updated last, linking every package page

items.label: Stages
items.value: Style guide, core docs, cli docs, web docs, index

items.label: Order
items.value: The style guide comes before all three package steps; the index comes after all three

items.label: At the same time
items.value: The three package steps run in parallel: none depends on another

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof (a command, test or file), budget

items.label: Limits
items.value: At most 6 steps and 5 owners

items.label: Format
items.value: JSON only, in the lesson's example shape, with "loops": []

criteria: Has a step that changes docs/STYLE.md, one step for each package folder, and a step that changes docs/index.md.
The style guide step comes before every package step, and the index step comes after all three.
The three package steps do not depend on each other and do not share a file.
Every step has a title, an owner, a changes list, a dependsOn list, a checkable proof and a budget.
No more than 6 steps and 5 owners; the goal says when the job is done.

challenges.title: Plan a database migration with a rehearsed rollback
challenges.brief: Get the model to plan a database migration as a JSON graph: back up, write the change and its rollback in parallel, review both, rehearse on staging, then apply and verify.

items.label: Change
items.value: Split users.full_name into first_name and last_name

items.label: Up file
items.value: migrations/0007_split_name.up.sql

items.label: Rollback file
items.value: migrations/0007_split_name.down.sql, which restores full_name

items.label: Backup
items.value: A step titled with "back up", "backup", "snapshot" or "dump" that changes only backups/

items.label: Rehearsal
items.value: A step titled with "rehearse", "dry run", "staging" or "trial" that runs up then down on a staging copy and writes reports/rehearsal.md

items.label: Apply
items.value: Runs the up file on production and writes reports/apply.md

items.label: Verify
items.value: Checks the converted rows and writes reports/verify.md

items.label: Stages
items.value: Backup, up migration, rollback, review, rehearsal, apply, verify

items.label: At the same time
items.value: The up file and the rollback file are written by two parallel steps, each changing only its own file

items.label: Review
items.value: Required: a step with "kind": "review" that depends on both migration steps

items.label: Order
items.value: Review before rehearsal; rehearsal and backup both before apply; apply before verify

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof (a command, test or file), budget

items.label: Limits
items.value: At most 8 steps and 5 owners

items.label: Format
items.value: JSON only, in the lesson's example shape, with "loops": []

criteria: Has backup, up migration, rollback, review, rehearsal, apply and verify steps, matched by the files and titles in the spec.
The up and rollback files are written by steps that can run at the same time and do not share a file.
A review step (kind review) depends on both migration steps.
Rehearsal follows the review; apply waits for both the rehearsal and the backup; verify follows apply.
Every step has a title, an owner, a changes list, a dependsOn list, a checkable proof and a budget.
No more than 8 steps and 5 owners; the goal says when the job is done.

challenges.title: Plan a prompt-tuning loop with a held-out set
challenges.brief: Get the model to plan a capped loop that tunes a prompt against a dev benchmark, with a check of the measure first and one final run on a held-out set the loop never sees.

items.label: Prompt
items.value: prompts/summarize.txt, the only file the tuning step changes

items.label: Dev set
items.value: 40 cases in benchmarks/dev/; scored with npm run bench -- benchmarks/dev

items.label: Held-out set
items.value: 20 cases in benchmarks/held_out/; no step in the loop, or before it, may read or change it

items.label: Round limit
items.value: At most 5 rounds

items.label: Stages
items.value: Baseline, check of the measure, score, tune, held-out check, report

items.label: Baseline
items.value: A step titled with "baseline" that scores the unchanged prompt on the dev set

items.label: Check the measure
items.value: A step titled with "validate", "calibrate" or "check" that compares the bench script with 5 hand-marked cases and writes reports/metric-check.md; it runs at the same time as the baseline

items.label: Loop
items.value: Declared in loops over a score step (titled "score", "evaluate" or "measure") and a tune step (titled "tune", "revise", "improve", "edit" or "fix"), with until, maxRounds of 5 or less and heldOut

items.label: Order
items.value: Baseline and the measure check before score; baseline before tune; score and tune before the held-out check (titled "held-out", "holdout", "hidden" or "final"); the held-out check before the report, which writes reports/benchmark.md

items.label: Each step
items.value: id, title, owner, dependsOn, changes, proof (a command, test or file), budget

items.label: Limits
items.value: At most 7 steps and 4 owners

items.label: Format
items.value: JSON only, in the lesson's example shape

criteria: Has baseline, measure check, score, tune, held-out check and report steps, matched by the files and titles in the spec.
The loop is declared over the score and tune steps, with a checkable until, maxRounds of 5 or less and a heldOut note.
No step in the loop, or before it, reads or changes benchmarks/held_out/.
The baseline and the measure check can run at the same time and do not share a file.
No cycle except inside the marked loop; every step has a title, owner, changes, dependsOn, a checkable proof and a budget.
No more than 7 steps and 4 owners; the goal says when the job is done.
